UPSC CSE 2026 Interview Schedule Announced for 2,526 Candidates

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has released the interview schedule for the Civil Services Examination (CSE) 2026. A total of 2,526 candidates are slated to appear for their interviews, which are set to commence on December 7.
